text: {"class":"fixable","chokepoint":[],"floor_ms":0,"L_delta":0,"rationale":"The contract freezes nothing, so no certificate is possible. With LC_ALL=C, -m equals the byte count. GNU takes the size from fstat, which is why its time (~1.1 ms) is mostly start-up. uutils likely reads all 32 MiB. Fix: use metadata size for -m in single-byte locales. That still leaves uutils' 2.1 ms start-up above the 1.67 ms target, so also cut start-up: static linking, fewer relocations, smaller binary or lazy dispatch."}
